extracted.intended_audience: writers of any skill level seeking peer critique, beta readers, and an online writing community
extracted.subtask_short: joining an online peer critique group
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for writers on using an online, points-based writing workshop to get and give critiques, find beta readers, and use community resources to improve manuscripts across genres and levels of experience.

rubrics_metrics.name: Points-based peer critique system
rubrics_metrics.description: Earn karma points by critiquing writing; spend karma points to post your own writing for critique.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The site uses a points-based peer critique system that 'guarantees you'll get feedback from writers from all walks of life.' Giving feedback is presented as 'fast, easy, fun, and helps improve your own writing, too!'

rubrics_metrics.name: Receive detailed feedback on how to improve
rubrics_metrics.description: When you post writing, the community will give 'detailed feedback on how to improve it,' regardless of specific genre.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the detailed feedback to 'polish your writing before you take the next step in your publishing journey.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Each critique offers a fresh perspective
rubrics_metrics.description: Every critique you receive on your manuscript is considered 'a fresh perspective' you can incorporate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The copy emphasizes incorporating multiple perspectives as part of manuscript improvement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Supportive community environment
rubrics_metrics.description: The community is presented as supportive—helping with encouragement, accountability, and removing the loneliness of the solitary craft.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Participation leads to friendships and relationships with other writers who become 'your inspiration, your encouragement, and even your beta readers.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Welcomes writers of all skill levels and genres
rubrics_metrics.description: The writing group 'welcomes writers of any skill level' from beginners to published authors and accepts work 'from flash fiction to novels.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The site positions itself as useful 'regardless of your specific genre,' implying inclusivity of formats and experience levels.

rubrics_metrics.name: Active forums for craft discussion
rubrics_metrics.description: The site hosts 'bustling writing forums' where writers discuss the craft 'twenty-four hours a day.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Forums are recommended for sharing inspiration, igniting creativity, getting support, and connecting with others.

rubrics_metrics.name: Writing Academy resources
rubrics_metrics.description: An 'extensive Writing Academy' contains articles on the art and business of writing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Academy provides 'insightful articles' intended to teach craft and publishing-related knowledge to members.

rubrics_metrics.name: Forming beta reader and critique relationships
rubrics_metrics.description: By participating you will 'meet and form relationships with many different kinds [of] writers' who can act as beta readers for current and future manuscripts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These relationships are framed as long-term supports for multiple projects, not just one-off feedback.

rubrics_metrics.name: Critiquing others improves your own writing
rubrics_metrics.description: Giving critiques is said to help you learn and improve—members report learning 'a huge amount from critiquing other people's work' and from reading critiques of their own.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Testimonials highlight that critiquing others contributed materially to members' publication success (agents, deals, shortlistings).

rubrics_metrics.name: Newsletter for markets, publishers, and contests
rubrics_metrics.description: A weekly newsletter delivers 'the latest publishers, writing markets, and writing contests' to members' inboxes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The newsletter is positioned as a free discovery tool to support the publishing journey; users may unsubscribe at any time.
